title: 1-1 prep - Avery Brooks / Devin Hughes
content:
1:1 prep - Avery -> Devin
Date: 2025-11-11 (30m)
Location: Zoom / async notes in Drive

Goals for this 1:1
- Quick sync on status: what progressed since last week, any new blockers.
- Check progress on kv-cache rollout and perf regressions.
- Career / growth check: IC->Staff roadmap items, any support needed.
- Action items & priorities for next week (release + oncall rotation).

Agenda (rough order)
1) Wins + quick updates (5m)
   - Ask: what went well this week? any small wins to call out for swipe or PR highlights.
   - I want to surface the telemetry dashboard spike you fixed (thanks)

2) Current blockers (8m)
   - KV cache rollout: last canary indicated tail latency increase on 2x sequences. You noted a hypothesis about batching interaction with the new cache eviction TTL.
     - Confirm what repro steps you have and where you need help (bench infra, test traffic, D-PR to revert parts).
   - Infra cost anomaly: you mentioned a quarterly budget alarm for Dedicated pool. Any immediate triage?

3) Tech deep / design decision (7m)
   - Decide on short-term mitigation vs full fix for kv-cache: are we comfortable with a shim that disables cache for problematic models for 72h while we gather traces? Pros/cons.
   - If go with shim: who's owner for rollout plan? (You proposed owning the rollback plan + monitoring).

4) Career / growth (5m)
   - Ask about interest in owning cross-team runbook (oncall training + playbooks).
   - Review progress on the Staff-level rubric: system design examples, cross-team influence. Identify 1-2 concrete examples for your promotion packet.

5) Action items / priorities (5m)
   - Confirm next steps and owners, sync cadence for the rollout.

Quick notes / prompts for Devin (things to ask)
- Do you have a short list of the top 3 follow-up experiments we should run on kv-cache? (latency by seq len, batch size distribution, model variants)
- Any blocker where an extra pair of hands from SRE or bench infra would unblock you this week?
- How comfortable are you with running the incident postmortem if the rollback happens?

Open questions I want answers to in this 1:1 (or async follow-up)
- Which models hit the tail-latency regression (ids)? rough % of traffic affected?
- Is there a reproducible load pattern that triggers the regression? (yes/no + steps)
- ETA for the instrumentation PR to capture KV hit/miss per request?

Action items going into the meeting (my expectations)
- Devin: drop a short doc in the linked confluence page with repro steps + perf numbers (due EOD Thu).
- Devin: propose mitigation plan (shim vs config tuning) with risk matrix (due Mon).
- Avery (me): escalate budget anomaly to finance + assign follow-up with Platform Sales (if Dedicated pool impact confirmed).

Follow-ups from last 1:1 (status)
- PR #832 (kv-cache eviction fix) — status: in review; you said CI flakes but tests passing locally. Next: rebase + address flaky test B (I can pair if time).
- Oncall handover doc — status: drafted, please add runbook links and tag SRE for review.

Tone & coaching notes (private)
- Give concrete praise for the telemetry dive — call out the query + the dashboards you built. This helps visibility.
- Encourage more cross-team sync early in rollout (a quick 15m sync with SRE + Bench infra might have found flake earlier).
- Push on delegation: if you're owning the rollback, identify 1-2 people who can execute specific steps so you aren't single point.

Potential talking points if conversation stalls
- Ask about career aspirations in next 6-12 months (Staff vs Tech Lead path).
- Ask what parts of the platform they enjoy least — anything we can remove from their plate.

Wrap-up checklist (before end of 1:1)
- Confirm top 3 priorities for next week (I want them in bullet form).
- Confirm action owners + deadlines.
- Offer 30m pairing slot to help rebase PR / reproduce the issue (I can do Thu afternoon).

Notes to self (post-meeting)
- Follow up with SRE on scheduling a 15m triage on Fri if Devin's repro is solid.
- Draft a quick intro note for Finance if Dedicated costs are real (copy team leads).

Misc scratch / raw thoughts (todo later)
- Consider adding a small SDK-level feature flag to toggle kv-cache per-model for faster rollback. Low friction, but need to validate cost/latency tradeoff.
- Capture examples for Devin's promotion packet: telemetry-driven root-cause + owning rollback plan + mentoring junior on running bench infra.

-- end of prep notes --

Unresolved: need model ids and traffic % (ask Devin), confirm CI flakes cause, decide mitigation approach.
